---
title: "Progression-free survival — endpoint preparation"
format: html
---

- PFS: first documented progression or death from randomization
- Follow-up runs to the data lock, no 182-day cap
- Same-day progression and death count as one event

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "05-progression-free-survival", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- read_parquet(here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"))
```

## Endpoint derivation

```{r}
#| label: derive-endpoint
#| include: false
endpoint <- derive_dated_event_endpoints(
  cohort,
  event_date_col = "progression_date",
  event_indicator_col = "progression",
  event_label = "progression",
  data_lock = config$analysis$data_lock
) |>
  rename(
    pfs_origin_date = origin_date,
    pfs_follow_up_limit = follow_up_limit,
    progression_extends_recorded_follow_up = extends_recorded_follow_up,
    progression_after_follow_up_limit = after_follow_up_limit,
    pfs_event_or_censor_date = event_or_censor_date,
    event_progression = event_first,
    event_death_before_progression = event_death_before_first,
    event_pfs = event_composite,
    pfs_censor_reason = censor_reason,
    pfs_time_days = time_days,
    pfs_exclusion_reason = exclusion_reason,
    pfs_in_analysis = in_analysis
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pfs_censor_reason = replace_values(
      pfs_censor_reason,
      "event_observed" ~ "progression_observed",
      "death_before_event" ~ "death_before_progression"
    ),
    pfs_exclusion_reason = replace_values(
      pfs_exclusion_reason,
      "event_before_randomization" ~ "progression_before_randomization"
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  all(endpoint$pfs_exclusion_reason %in% c(
    "included", "progression_before_randomization", "no_positive_follow_up"
  )),
  all(endpoint$event_pfs ==
        endpoint$event_progression + endpoint$event_death_before_progression),
  all(endpoint$event_pfs >= endpoint$event_progression),
  # The follow-up limit carries the data lock on the shifted date scale.
  all(endpoint$pfs_event_or_censor_date <= endpoint$pfs_follow_up_limit),
  all(endpoint$pfs_time_days <= endpoint$potential_follow_up_days),
  all(endpoint$data_lock == config$analysis$data_lock)
)
```

## Analysis dataset

```{r}
#| label: prepare-analysis-data
#| include: false
prepared <- endpoint |>
  filter(pfs_in_analysis) |>
  # The column order sets the MICE visit sequence.
  select(
    id, tx, pfs_time_days, event_pfs, diagnosis, ecog_fstcnt, stage_binary,
    lung, age, gender, albumin, bilirubin, c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(prepared) > 0L,
  sum(prepared$event_pfs) > 0L,
  !anyNA(prepared$diagnosis),
  all(prepared$pfs_time_days > 0)
)

endpoint_audit <- endpoint |>
  count(tx, pfs_exclusion_reason, name = "participants")

event_counts <- endpoint |>
  filter(pfs_in_analysis) |>
  summarise(
    participants = n(),
    progression_first = sum(event_progression),
    death_before_progression = sum(event_death_before_progression),
    pfs_events = sum(event_pfs),
    censored = sum(event_pfs == 0),
    .by = tx
  )

write_parquet(endpoint, file.path(results_dir, "endpoint.parquet"))
write_parquet(prepared, file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
write_parquet(endpoint_audit, file.path(results_dir, "endpoint-audit.parquet"))
write_parquet(event_counts, file.path(results_dir, "event-counts.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pfs-exclusions
#| tbl-cap: "PFS analysis population and exclusions"
kable(endpoint_audit)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pfs-event-counts
#| tbl-cap: "First progression or death events by randomized group"
kable(event_counts)
```
